title: First stage
summary: Connects the centre with Lasnamäe along Laagna tee, with Peetri and Assaku in Rae municipality and with Pelgulinn; builds the Liivalaia, Rävala and Gonsiori links in the centre and a frequent train service Balti jaam – Vesse with an interchange at Kristiine.

title: Second stage
summary: Connects the centre with Viimsi, northern Lasnamäe and Mustamäe, and adds the Juhkentali link between the Liivalaia and Laagna tee corridors.

title: Third stage
summary: Connects Tabasalu, Väike-Õismäe and Astangu, continues in Põhja-Tallinn (Kalaranna, Pelguranna) and joins Mustamäe with Väike-Õismäe.

title: Fourth stage
summary: Joins Mustamäe with Ülemiste along Tammsaare tee and Järvevana tee, adds a line inside Ülemiste City, the tunnel link under the Ülemiste junction, the outer part of the Rae line to Jüri and the Toompuiestee link, and takes the Bekkeri port railway into passenger use.

title: Fifth stage
summary: Connects Maardu beyond the end of Laagna tee and extends existing lines along Peterburi tee and Pärnu mnt to Järve, with a link from Järve to Mustamäe.
